indexFields.characteristic: 稳定失去体力并获得大量的手牌，觉醒后可以控制自己的技能。输出能力较弱。
indexFields.biography: 字伯约，天水冀人。蜀汉著名将领、军事统帅。原为曹魏天水郡的中郎将，后降蜀汉，官至凉州刺史、大将军。诸葛亮去世后继承诸葛亮的遗志，继续率领蜀汉军队北伐曹魏，与曹魏名将陈泰、郭淮、邓艾等多次交手。

genderEvidence.basis: Historical identity and the visually inspected official portrait. Male is an inference, not an explicit current API gender field.

artwork.visualObservation: Young male figure in blue armor holding a sword, with one hand against his chest; banners and soldiers behind him, with another figure and papers in the foreground.

skills.name: 困奋
skills.text: 锁定技，结束阶段，你失去1点体力，然后摸两张牌。
skills.mapping: Mandatory owner TurnEnding loses one real HP, awaits HP and possible Dying children, then draws two real cards. A paid parent continues once after its original skill is replaced during Fengliang.

skills.name: 逢亮
skills.text: 觉醒技，当你进入濒死状态时，你减少1点体力上限并回复至2点体力，获得“挑衅”并修改“困奋”。
skills.mapping: Once per game, mandatory owner DyingEntering reduces maximum HP by one, applies genuine recovery to two HP clamped to the current maximum, acquires the ordinary per-Play Tiaoxin, then replaces original locked Kunfen with the optional non-locked version.

skills.name: 困奋
skills.text: 结束阶段，你可以失去1点体力，然后摸两张牌。
skills.textOrigin: implementation paraphrase of non-locked Kunfen, expanded using historical official OL explanations
skills.mapping: Optional owner TurnEnding retains real lose-HP-before-draw ordering and no Locked tag.

historicalQuotes.text: 觉醒技，当你进入濒死状态时，你减1点体力上限并将体力值回复至2点，然后获得技能"挑衅"，并将技能"困奋"改为非锁定技。
在“逢亮”发动后，“困奋”将从锁定技变为非锁定技

notes: The current hero/139 page says modify Kunfen without expanding the modified description. The two historical official OL pages clarify that Kunfen becomes non-locked.
The displayed optional modified text is an implementation paraphrase, not a quotation presented as current hero/139 text.
Original Kunfen and acquired Kunfen have separate identities and tags; a Boolean gate on an always-Locked definition would not represent the modified skill correctly.

skills.name: 挑衅
skills.text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以令一名攻击范围内包含你的角色对你使用一张【杀】，否则你弃置其一张牌。
skills.textOrigin: current ordinary Jiang Wei hero/52 exact text
skills.mapping: One activation per actual Play phase, selects another living player whose attack range includes the owner, requests a real Slash from that player, and only on declined request lets the owner discard one actual target HE card while awaiting movement children.

historicalQuotes.text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择一名攻击范围内含有你的其他角色，该角色需对你使用一张【杀】，否则你弃置其一张牌。
出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择一名攻击范围内含有你的角色，然后除非该角色对你使用一张【杀】，否则你弃置其一张牌。

notes: Current hero/139 names Tiaoxin but does not expand it. The expansion uses current ordinary hero/52 plus the two historical official OL SP announcements.

Existing classic:tiaoxin has a once-per-turn quota; this independent binding reuses the same actions but preserves the official once-per-Play-phase quota, including inserted Play phases. The existing classic binding is not edited.
Boundary/current Jie Tiaoxin is not reused. Self-targeting is excluded by request-Slash legality and the 2015 SP announcement explicitly says another player.

timingInterpretation.implementationInference: DyingEntering is the engine owner-victim entry boundary before rescue continuation. It maps the official enters-Dying timing. TurnEnding maps the owner Ending phase skill offer. Exact frame boundaries, typed child ordering, once-only parent continuation after source replacement and permanent-grant preservation are implementation contracts, not explicit current official FAQ assertions.
timingInterpretation.evidenceBoundary: Current hero/139 controls the two printed skills and metadata. Current hero/52 expands ordinary Tiaoxin; the 2015 and 2018 official OL announcements clarify the acquired skill and modified Kunfen. Historical news prose saying recover 2 is not used to replace the current and formal recover-to-2 rule. No Ten-Year sources or Jie Tiaoxin replace current SP rules.

observations: All seven listed primary HTTP sources returned 200 when this record was captured.

The current API has no explicit gender field; Male is documented as an inference.
